newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee skids against dollar in thin market.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee skids against dollar in thin market.

text.p: *The Indian rupee closed at 35.69/70 per dollar on Thursday, down from the opening quote of 35.67/68, dealers said.
*Dealers said some import covering in an extremely thin market pulled the rupee down. The market was very thin on the last day of the week-long Ganesh festival, dealers said.
*Dealers said most of the day's deals were at 35.69 level. Some stray deals at 35.70 were also reported.
*The six month annualised dollar premia closed at 9.35 percent, little changed from the previous close, dealers said.
